title: Tape Thirteen
logline: Thirteen home videos from one house, each a different year, and in every one something stands a little closer to the camera.
look: 1990s camcorder VHS: soft chroma bleed, tracking lines, timestamp burn-in, tape dropouts, missed frames; sodium-orange interiors, green-black night.
narrator: female, middle-aged, low pitch, american accent
music: No score. Room tone, tape hiss, a low sub hum that rises with each tape; a held silence before the last reveal; tape eject clunk.

shots.direction: black · tracking noise · cut — timestamp OCT 14 1994 fades in; a living room birthday party
MS handheld · drift · cut — kids around a cake; in the background, a dark hallway doorway
WS handheld · slow pan · cut — the backyard; at the tree line, a figure stands between the trees, barely visible
MS · tripod locked · cut — night, a kid's bedroom; the figure now stands in the doorway, closer
CU handheld · cut — a mirror: the father filming; behind him, the figure
freeze frame · digital zoom · cut — pixelated zoom on the figure: it is holding a camcorder
WS · locked · hard cut — new timestamp OCT 15 2026; a dark room; the tape playing on an old TV
CU · slow push · cut — on the TV, the figure turns toward the lens
CU · slow push · cut — it walks toward the camera; static swells
CU · locked · cut — in the TV glass, a reflection: the figure standing behind the viewer, camcorder raised
black · cut — tape eject; text: TAPE 13 OF 13

narration.text: We found thirteen tapes in the house.
Every tape is a different year. Same house.
And in every tape, it's a little closer.
